title: Community Update
content: We would like to remind everyone that this server is my part time hobby and not a full time service of which i'm obliged to provide. The server is now in a test phase to narrow down current issues, this will involve (in my spare time) Checking 1000's of lines of code. Removing and replacing old and none updated mods (notice will be given). Server downtime (notice will be given). I would suggest building with BBP only for now.
author: T0nka
